name: TraceSync: Real-Time Collaborative IDE
desc: Architected a scalable collaborative IDE featuring real-time code synchronization using Socket.IO and Redis Pub/Sub for low-latency presence updates. Built a multi-language execution pipeline (C++, Python, Java, JS) with RabbitMQ, integrated Google Generative AI for code review, and designed a secure JWT-based authentication system.

name: Social Media Platform
desc: Full-stack social media application with RESTful API architecture. Engineered optimized backend services for authentication, hierarchical follow graphs, and post interactions for 200+ test users. Implemented robust MongoDB data models with horizontal scaling support for profile management and dynamic feeds.

name: Twitter Clone
desc: Developed a full-stack web application using the MERN stack with features for following/unfollowing, deleting/liking/unliking posts.

name: E-commerce Website
desc: Full-Stack E-commerce website using MERN with Admin Dashboard and Paytm Payment Gateway. MERN Stack tech, ready to use for business.

name: Amazon-Clone
desc: Amazon clone using HTML and CSS, replicating core layout components such as the header, search bar, product grid, and footer.

name: Notes-App
desc: Notes application using the MERN stack, allowing users to register, log in, and securely create, edit, update, or delete personal notes.
